Presenting PEENE WALE KO PEENE KA BAHANA CHAHIYE FULL VIDEO SONG from HAATH KI SAFAI movie starring Vinod Khanna, Hema Malini, Randhir Kapoor & Simi Garewal in lead roles, released on 1974. The song is sung by Hema Malini, Kishore Kumar and music is given by Kalyanji-Anandji, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song : PEENE WALE KO PEENE KA BAHANA CHAHIYE
Singer: HEMA MALINI, KISHORE KUMAR
Music Director: KALYANJI-ANANDJI
Lyricist: GULSHAN BAWRA
Vinod Khanna won the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor for this film.
